documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Intimation Of Grant Of Options Under OFSS Stock Plan 2014

analysis.summary: Oracle Financial Services Software reported consolidated revenues of ₹ 76.7 billion for FY 2025-26, marking a 12% increase over the previous year. Net income rose by 11% to ₹ 26.4 billion, with the company maintaining an operating margin of 44%. The company focused on AI-led innovation and cloud services, launching several new cloud-based banking solutions during the year. The Board declared two interim dividends totaling ₹ 400 per share for the financial year. Oracle Financial Services Software reported consolidated revenues of ₹ 68.5 billion for FY 2024-25, representing a 7% growth over the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry is undergoing a transformation toward AI-first, cloud-native, and composable architectures.
demand_outlook.quote: The financial services industry is entering a new phase of technology transformation in which AI-first, cloud-native, and composable architectures are becoming central to how institutions compete, and serve customers.

demand_outlook.claim: The business landscape was impacted by global uncertainties and geo-political challenges, leading to demand challenges in the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Banks are increasingly seeking cloud-based solutions that are adaptable to rapid change.
demand_outlook.quote: Banks are increasingly looking at solutions delivered on a new architecture which is adaptable to rapid change and is available on the cloud.

demand_outlook.claim: Financial institutions are under pressure to deliver digital services while maintaining regulatory compliance and cost efficiency.
demand_outlook.quote: With an increasingly tech savvy customer base which is spoilt for choice, banks are under intense pressure to deliver “digital delight” at scale with complete compliance to regulations and at the lowest possible cost.

capex_expansion.claim: The company significantly expanded its cloud services portfolio for the banking industry during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we significantly expanded our cloud services portfolio for the banking industry with the launch of Oracle Banking Retail Lending Servicing Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Collections Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Cash Management Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Supply Chain Management Cloud Service, and Oracle Banking Trade Finance Cloud Service.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved an operating margin of 44% during the financial year.
margins_costs.quote: We also continued to maintain strong financial discipline, resulting in an operating margin of 44%, reflecting the Company's consistent focus on execution and operational efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: The company's operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% compared to 42% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: We continued to maintain a strong financial discipline while driving the growth, and our operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% as compared to 42% in the last financial year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company signed multiple multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers globally.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company signed a number of multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers across the world which are a testimony to the excellence of our products through continuing R&D, our track record of delivering high quality implementations, and providing reliable support.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved its highest-ever license wins of $137 million in fiscal year 2024.
orders_capacity.quote: The fiscal year 2024 saw license wins of $137M – highest ever for the Company, registering a 44% growth over last fiscal.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling ₹ 400 per share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling ₹ 400 per share for FY 2025-26.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved an interim dividend of ₹ 265 per share for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board was pleased to approve an interim dividend of ₹ 265 per share for the financial year 2024-25, 10.4% higher than the dividend paid in the last financial year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Regulatory requirements regarding transparency, security, and data privacy are expected to intensify.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, regulatory requirements around transparency, security, entitlement controls, human oversight, monitoring, and operational data residency/privacy are likely to intensify.

risks_headwinds.claim: The business environment was characterized by global uncertainties and geopolitical challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fiscal year 2024 was impacted by geopolitical conflicts, economic slowdowns, and bank failures.
risks_headwinds.quote: Fiscal year 2024 was fraught with several uncertainties including continued and expanding geopolitical conflicts, economic slowdowns, highly visible failures of some banks in the western world, and tectonic technology shifts with increasing usage of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) and machine learning (ML).

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to broaden and deepen various potential markets globally.
management_commitments.quote: The Company will continue to broaden and deepen various potential markets globally.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to delivering sustainable value, pioneering innovation, and maintaining high governance standards.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering sustainable value, pioneering innovation and maintaining the highest standards of governance.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
